english.title: Trespass on land with an air weapon
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), while having with you an air weapon, namely **(..SPECIFY THE WEAPON..), entered or were on land, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LAND..), as a trespasser and without reasonable excuse
english.legislation: Contrary to section 20(2) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

english.notes:
(i) See also offence wordings H485, H499 and H500.
(ii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).
(iii) See also Home Office Guidance on Firearms Licensing Law.
